conditions.notes: OBS-0004, at F2, announced that the field could observe its own accepted-state sequence via the chronicle and recorded F0→F1→F2. OBS-0014 applies that capacity later and finds the committed chronicle did not keep pace with the sequence it was built to show, while the sequence itself admitted non-acceptance events into first-parent numbering. Same instrument, later time, different reading: the self-observation loop exists, but its committed display and its acceptance semantics have aged into partial fiction. Not a contradiction of OBS-0004's then-accurate report — an at-another-time stress test of the practice it inaugurated.
